state:
Goal `core-time-and-1-more`: every `Core\Time` member has all its feature proofs, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Time'` and `--group 'Core\Cldr'` both print "nothing owed". The `Core\Time` group itself owes nothing.
The stage's last check, `proofs: Core\Time\Date`, covers six members, not three: `minus`, `with` and `compareTo` now have examples, an attack, a bench, `.nvst` cases and a Rust `#[test]`. `plus`, `format` and `at` still owe examples, an attack and a bench each. `format` and `at` also owe a Rust `#[test]` with a `// covers:` marker. `plus` has one (`date_minus_is_plus_negated_and_refuses_a_unit_or_count_it_cannot_take` covers both).
Three existing `time-date-*.nvst` cases now carry `// covers:` markers, so every Date member has enough `.nvst` cases.
`with`'s attack found that a `uint` option past the `int` range ended the request with a FATAL in all three `with` members. `optional` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` now reads it as `i64::MAX`, so each member throws its field's out-of-range sentence. `tests/conformance/core/time-with-members-throw-for-a-uint-past-the-int-range.nvst` pins this.
Any `time.rs` edit stales every `Core\Time` figure, and this session edited it. The session that closes the stage re-runs `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Time'` and `--group 'Core\Time\Date'` after its last edit.

The `minus`, `with` and `compareTo` directories there show the shape.

items.text: **`Core\Time\Date::plus`** — owes examples, hostile and perf (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:2495`, body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4681`. Its Rust test and `.nvst` cases already exist.

**`Core\Time\Date::format`** — owes examples, hostile, perf and a Rust `#[test]` with `// covers: Core\Time\Date::format`. Body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4659`. `date_called` in the test module cannot read a string return, so the test needs its own call.

**`Core\Time\Date::at`** — owes examples, hostile, perf and a Rust `#[test]` with `// covers: Core\Time\Date::at`. Body at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4636`. Then run `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Time'` and `--group 'Core\Time\Date'`, and check that `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Time\Date'` prints "nothing owed".

A plain sentence here would change `tests/conformance/core/time-date-ends-refuse-where-the-clock-wraps.nvst` and `docs/examples/core/Time-Date/with/02-a-date-that-does-not-exist.out` — owner: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs` module doc.
